name: rocky
description: rocky — the owner's personal agent toolkit. Run many agent sessions from one machine: hand work out (board, handoffs, spawn), bring results back to merge (PR watch, default-branch verify, review-fix), watch and steer from anywhere (web UI, remote control, statusline), and record it all (worklog, token and usage logs). A Rust daemon (127.0.0.1:8636: board REST + streamable HTTP MCP todo_* / note_* / token_*, web UI) and CLI; this plugin is its thin Claude Code client. worklog_* is served per project by the CLI's stdio MCP server (`rocky mcp worklog`). Hooks: SessionStart boots the daemon, UserPromptSubmit injects human board changes, PostToolUse attributes a self-started doing to the session, Stop claims handoffs and auto-captures the turn. Slash commands, skills and subagents (reviewer, quick-fix, merge-cleanup) cover picking work, PR flow from gate to merge, setup and usage review.
